description: Insert a four-line CI step between two steps. DISTILL-CANARY-36ac1441

files..ci/pipeline-build.yml:
name: build
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install
        run: npm ci
      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test
  package:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm pack

turns.prompt: Add a Lint step to the test job in .ci/pipeline-build.yml, between Install and Unit tests. It runs `npm run lint` and sets the env var CI to true. Read the workflow back to make sure the indentation lines up, then tell me which line the package job starts on.
Also rename the workflow itself to build-and-pack.

.ci/pipeline-build.yml.equals:
name: build-and-pack
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install
        run: npm ci
      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test
  package:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm pack
